name.zh: 高性能计算与数据工程实验室（HPCDE Lab）

description.zh: 公开站点使用“北京科技大学高性能计算与数据工程实验室”名称，团队目录列有李建江老师及多位研究人员。其研究背景涵盖高性能计算与数据工程。
description.en: The public site identifies a high-performance computing and data engineering laboratory at USTB. Its directory includes Professor Jianjiang Li alongside other researchers.

scope.zh: 这是相关科研平台，不等同于本网站的李建江老师个人课题组。目录中的往届名单未注明具体导师，暂不据此填入本站成员或毕业生。
scope.en: This is a related research platform with a broader scope than the group presented here. Its alumni directory does not identify individual supervisors, so those names are not imported as Professor Li’s students or alumni.

name.zh: 智能超算融合应用技术教育部工程研究中心
name.en: Engineering Research Center for Integrated Intelligent Supercomputing Applications, Ministry of Education

description.zh: 中心2021年公开团队简介列有李建江老师，介绍其高性能计算、云计算与大数据研究，以及并行程序设计相关教学著作。
description.en: The center’s 2021 team profile lists Professor Li and describes his work in high-performance computing, cloud computing and big data, together with books on parallel programming.

scope.zh: 中心包含多位教师及不同研究方向，中心整体成果和人数不作为李老师个人课题组的统计。
scope.en: The center includes several faculty members and research areas. Center-wide results and headcounts are not presented as those of Professor Li’s individual group.
